Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D wizard roguelike for phone/tablet where players compose spells from delivery methods, effects, attributes, and twists, then tap to aim and cast.

## Requirements
- Deliver a playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Support responsive phone/tablet play with touch controls.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built a standalone browser game titled “Witchlight,” with keyboard and touch movement, tap-to-aim casting, and selectable spell crafting.
- Chose endless escalating waves, enemy encounters, XP/level progression, health, and retry after defeat as the roguelike loop.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the game in `index.html` with canvas rendering, responsive interface, spell composition, combat, waves, progression, audio toggle, and touch joystick.
- Verified script syntax with `node --check /tmp/opencode/game.js`.
- Opened the game in Playwright and confirmed changing delivery to Beam updates the spell to “Starline.”
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/witchlight.jpg` and `screenshots/witchlight-mobile.jpg`.

### Active
- No active work.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. If further validation is desired, retest after the latest health-display and favicon fixes; the screenshots were captured before those final fixes.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `screenshots/witchlight.jpg`: Desktop viewport capture.
- `screenshots/witchlight-mobile.jpg`: Mobile viewport capture.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Local preview was served at `http://localhost:3002`; Playwright reported no page errors after reload, though browser-level checks were limited.
